scenes.headline: What a small model's price cut is made of
scenes.sub: Price, tokenizer, tier and effort, multiplied together
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Farthing! Anthropic says its new small model costs about seventy-five percent less to run. Let's take that apart.

scenes.text: Cost per task is the price ratio times the token ratio. The prices fell tenfold. The token count did not stay put.
scenes.say: Cost per task is the price ratio times the token ratio. Prices fell tenfold. Tokens per job did not stay put.

scenes.title: One line for the whole comparison
scenes.text: cost ratio = price ratio x token ratio
scenes.say: Every new price is the same fraction of the old one.

parts.note: a tenth below the threshold, half above it
parts.say: A tenth for short prompts, a half for long ones.

parts.note: tokenizer, thinking and effort all push it up
parts.say: The token ratio is where it gets interesting.

scenes.title: How one request gets its price

steps.say: The new tokenizer counts the same text as about thirty percent more tokens.
That sets the prompt length, in the new model's tokens.
One check. Is the prompt over a hundred thousand tokens?
If not, every token costs a tenth of the old price.
If it is, every token in that request costs half. All of them, not just the extra ones.

scenes.title: Output tokens per task, by effort
scenes.say: Effort is the other lever. The old model used about eighteen thousand output tokens per task. Medium uses thirty-three thousand. Max, a hundred and sixty-two thousand.

steps.say: Anthropic's own chart for a knowledge-work benchmark. Cost runs along the bottom.

steps.note: the old model's point, and the max point to its right
steps.say: The old model sits in the middle. The max point, the one in the launch table, sits to its right. It costs more.

left.title: Max effort
items: Costs more on three of four charts
left.say: At max effort, behind the launch table, it costs more per task on three of four charts.

right.title: Medium effort, the default
right.say: At medium, the default, it is fourteen to ninety-three percent cheaper, and far better.

scenes.text: The price is fixed. The bill is set by your prompt length and your effort setting.

recap: Cost ratio is price ratio times token ratio
Past 100k tokens, the whole request costs more
Medium effort is where the savings live
scenes.say: Multiply the ratios, recount your prompts, and pick the effort before the model.
